scope: Public-data computational/literature falsification and representation audit only. No pathogen engineering, wet-lab protocol, clinical treatment claim, or operational viral manipulation.
question: Can the JANUS/TRUMP Mirror-Reverse viral pathway program be driven from retrospective relevance to a defensible scientific breakthrough using currently available public evidence in this pass?
why: The C025 BMV pre-freeze test produced 3/3 mechanism-class literature hits, supporting method relevance, but the confirming observations were already prior art and latent model knowledge cannot be excluded.
The C027 Triatoma-virus holdout was contaminated by search-result leakage before freeze and was correctly voided.
The C026 Portal-or-Contact Duality was falsified as a general law by picornavirus evidence supporting host-context-induced stochastic symmetry breaking in a previously symmetric particle.
Broader taxonomies of inherent versus life-cycle-induced viral asymmetry are established prior art.

The generic idea that coarse-grained forward/reverse discrepancies expose hidden variables, memory, or irreversibility overlaps established hidden-Markov, coarse-graining and stochastic-thermodynamics theory.
Unique portal vertices used for genome packaging and ejection are established in dsDNA phage/herpes systems, preventing a novelty claim based on shared forward/reverse portal coordinates.
No new raw-data-derived observable was extracted in this pass that is both previously unreported and independently replicated.
valid_positive_results: Mirror-Reverse typed debt is a coherent representation audit that distinguishes state, edge, context, observation and cargo-shell insufficiency rather than merely labeling all pathways asymmetric.
Explicit reversible controls prevent the audit from treating every viral process as an anomaly.
The BMV session-level pre-freeze exercise demonstrates useful hypothesis-class generation, but not human-level novelty.
The chain successfully falsified its own attractive C026 generalization and preserved the failure instead of retargeting post hoc.
Search-engine leakage was promoted to an explicit data-leakage firewall after the TrV holdout contamination.

scientific_breakthrough_claim.reason: No candidate survived novelty, independent confirmation, cross-system/general-law and material-consequence requirements simultaneously.

outreach.reason: User policy and C024 require SCIENTIFIC_BREAKTHROUGH with independent PASS receipts before contacting researchers.

remaining_nontrivial_frontier.name: ORIGINAL_RAW_TRAJECTORY_INFORMATION_GAIN

freeze a quantitative analysis question and scoring rule before outcome inspection
extract a previously unreported observable or discriminating prediction
replicate it on an independent viral system or independent dataset

supersedes: C026 as a live general-law candidate
